subject: complete Java-source coverage run over the shipped package

reader.tool: jadx 1.5.6 (release bundle from the project's own release page)
reader.note: inlining disabled because the default inliner wedged indefinitely on generated classes (two runs, 53 % and 60 %, zero output for 13+ minutes)

runs.mode: per-code-file slices, 2 in parallel, 3 GB heap each, 900 s cap per slice
two sweeps of 11 and 12 slices, 2 in parallel each, 2 GB heap each
runs.note: identical total and identical per-slice counts to the other host

hard_error_split.other_concentration: 204 files in the Adyen 3-D Secure package (atd), 12 in androidx.*, the rest spread across obfuscated library packages

coverage_measurement.meaning: a hard marker means the reader emitted the class but had to fall back for at least one member; it does not mean the class is absent. The class declaration and all successfully read members are still present in the file.

reconciliation.explanation: one source file per top-level type; inner types are emitted inside their outer class, so file count and definition count are different measures of the same code, not a discrepancy

artifacts_location.this_host: open code temp folder, sweepA/out and sweepB/out
